audit_items.proof_trace: All member-team resolution queries in `updateMemberTeams` use Supabase SDK `.eq()` calls (L582, L592, L598), which generate PostgREST parameterized requests — no raw SQL is constructed. `discord_uid` is never used as a SQL query parameter: it is only retrieved from the DB at L598 as an output field and then forwarded to `syncDiscordRoles()` as a JSON body in an HTTP fetch call. Input validation via Zod UUID schema (L568-569) also enforces structural integrity of `memberId` before any DB access.
